title: Stock Warrants and Stock Rights
learning_objectives: Account for bond issuance with detachable warrants
Allocate proceeds between bonds and warrants

definitions.stock_warrant: Right to purchase shares at specified price (exercise price) for specified period. Often issued with bonds to make offering more attractive.
definitions.stock_right: Short-term privilege to purchase additional shares, typically given to existing shareholders (preemptive rights)

detachable_warrants.definition: Can be separated from bond and traded independently
detachable_warrants.accounting: Allocate proceeds between bonds (based on FV) and warrants (based on FV) using relative fair value method
detachable_warrants.reason: Two separate securities with independent values

nondetachable_warrants.definition: Cannot be separated from bond (must exercise both together)
nondetachable_warrants.accounting: No allocation. All proceeds assigned to bonds. Warrants have no separate value.

allocation_of_proceeds.formula: Bond proceeds = Total proceeds × (FV of bonds / (FV of bonds + FV of warrants)). Warrant proceeds = Total proceeds × (FV of warrants / (FV of bonds + FV of warrants)).
allocation_of_proceeds.bond_discount: Bonds recorded at allocated amount (usually less than face value → discount)
allocation_of_proceeds.apic_warrants: Warrants recorded in Additional Paid-In Capital - Stock Warrants

calculation_example_issuance.facts: Issue $100K face bonds with 1,000 detachable warrants. Total proceeds $108K. FV: Bonds without warrants $104K, Warrants $4K. Total FV $108K.
calculation_example_issuance.entry: DR Cash $108K, CR Bonds Payable $104K, CR APIC - Stock Warrants $4K
calculation_example_issuance.note: Bonds issued at premium ($104K > $100K face). This is unusual but follows from allocation.

alternative_calculation.if_only_one_fv_known: Can use incremental method (allocate known FV first, residual to other)
alternative_calculation.example: Total proceeds $108K. FV of bonds $105K. FV of warrants unknown. Allocate $105K to bonds, $3K residual to warrants.

warrant_exercise.entry: DR Cash (exercise price), DR APIC - Stock Warrants (original allocation), CR Common Stock (par), CR APIC (excess)
warrant_exercise.example: 1,000 warrants (APIC $4K) exercised at $10 each. Par $1. DR Cash $10K, DR APIC - Warrants $4K, CR Common Stock $1K (1,000 × $1), CR APIC $13K

warrant_expiration.if_not_exercised: Transfer APIC - Stock Warrants to APIC (or other paid-in capital)
warrant_expiration.entry: DR APIC - Stock Warrants, CR APIC
warrant_expiration.note: No gain or loss on expiration (already in equity)

stock_rights_to_shareholders.issuance: Usually no entry when rights granted (unless represents dividend)
stock_rights_to_shareholders.exercise: Record stock issuance at exercise price
stock_rights_to_shareholders.purpose: Allow existing shareholders to maintain proportionate ownership (preemptive rights)

diluted_eps_impact.warrants_dilutive: Use treasury stock method (same as stock options)
diluted_eps_impact.calculation: Assume warrants exercised, proceeds used to buy back shares at average market price. Net increase in shares = Warrants - (Warrants × Exercise price / Market price).

comparison_to_convertible_bonds.convertible_bonds: Cannot separate debt and equity components (ASC 470). All proceeds to debt.
comparison_to_convertible_bonds.bonds_with_detachable_warrants: Separate debt and equity components. Allocate proceeds.

cpa_exam_tips: Detachable warrants: Allocate proceeds using relative FV (bonds get portion, warrants get portion)
Nondetachable warrants: All proceeds to bonds (no allocation)
Allocation reduces bond proceeds → Creates or increases bond discount
Exercise: DR Cash (exercise price) + DR APIC-Warrants, CR Common Stock (par) + CR APIC (excess)
Diluted EPS: Warrants use treasury stock method (same as options)

allocation_steps: 1. Determine if detachable (allocate) or nondetachable (no allocation)
2. If detachable: Calculate total FV (bonds FV + warrants FV)
4. Bonds: Allocated amount. Warrants: Allocated amount to APIC.
cpa_exam_strategies.exercise_entry: DR Cash (exercise price × warrants exercised), DR APIC-Warrants (allocated amount), CR Common Stock (shares × par), CR APIC (plug)
common_mistakes: Allocating proceeds for nondetachable warrants (should not allocate)
Forgetting to use relative FV method (allocating equally or using other method)
Not reducing bonds payable for warrant allocation (creates discount)
Recording gain/loss on warrant expiration (should transfer within equity)

key_points: Detachable warrants: Allocate proceeds using relative FV method
Nondetachable warrants: No allocation, all proceeds to bonds
Allocation: Bonds get portion (usually creates discount), Warrants get portion (to APIC)
Exercise: DR Cash + APIC-Warrants, CR Common Stock + APIC
Expiration: Transfer APIC-Warrants to APIC (no gain/loss)
Diluted EPS: Use treasury stock method for warrants
